locked.title: See who, before they cancel
locked.body: Clash Pro names everyone who’s slipping or drifting, with when they usually come in, a morning email when someone starts, a one-tap nudge from POWR, and a log of who you reached out to and who came back.

how.title: How it works
how.normalTitle: Their normal, not a fixed rule
how.normalBody: Each person is measured against their own usual gap between visits. Someone who trains daily is drifting after a week; someone who comes weekly, after about three.
how.hereBody: Only the days and times POWR checked them in at {{gym}}. Never their other training, health data or where they are.
how.choiceBody: Members can switch this off in the POWR app (Settings, then Privacy). Anyone who does disappears from this page.

poster.title: Get your members on POWR
poster.intro: Everything here counts members who picked {{gym}} as their gym in the app. This poster does the telling: a QR that opens the app, and a line that says why.
poster.kit: One ZIP: A4 for the wall and A5 for the counter (3 mm bleed, any printer), plus Post, Story and Square for your feed, and the caption to paste. Type on black, the house look, no photo needed.
poster.downloaded: Downloaded. Print the A4, post the rest.
poster.linkNote: Opens the POWR app, or the app store for someone new. Send it in your welcome email or WhatsApp group, and ask people to pick {{gym}} as their gym in the app: that is what puts them on your board.

places.title: Three places it works
places.deskBody: The A5 by the till, the A4 on the wall people face when they check in. Staff point at it at induction.
places.feedBody: The Post and the Story once, then again with the first event. The caption is in the ZIP.
places.welcomeBody: The link, one line: every session here counts, get the app and pick us as your gym.

poster.screens: Put the board on the TV
